planets.name: Kepler-90 g
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 211-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-90 g was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Shaw et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SHAW_ET_AL__2025): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 8; pl_orbper 210.73514, pl_radj 0.68855503, pl_bmassj 0.04719528

quotes.title: Kepler-90g
quotes.card: Kepler-90g is a super-puff exoplanet orbiting the early G-type main sequence star Kepler-90, one of eight planets around this star discovered using NASA's Kepler space telescope.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 2,840 light-years (870 pc) from Earth, in the constellation Draco.
